content: Wiz CTO Ami Luttwak argues that AI accelerates attacks, creating a "Black October" where vulnerabilities are exploited faster than organizations can respond. Luttwak emphasizes that security strategies relying on human timelines are obsolete; companies must adopt continuous, automated defense models to keep pace with the speed of modern, AI-driven threats.

title: 磁带不是早就“死”了吗，怎么突然打赢复活赛了
content: Magnetic tape storage has experienced a significant resurgence, driven by increasing data archiving demands, particularly from AI applications. Major manufacturers like Fujifilm are expanding production capacities. Modern enterprise tapes offer high capacities and cost efficiency for cold storage, where data is accessed infrequently. Unlike active drives, offline tapes provide superior security against digital threats and consume minimal power, making them a vital, long-term archival solution for large-scale data management.

title: 硅谷L4程序媛：AI导致「工作时长」怒翻一倍 | 原文
content: A Silicon Valley software engineer at level L4 reports that AI integration doubled her daily working hours from four to eight or nine. Despite AI’s efficiency, supervisors often assign more tasks or increase oversight, preventing reduced workloads. This phenomenon occurs because employers primarily purchase employee time. Furthermore, supervising AI outputs requires significant mental effort, similar to the demanding task of grading a class rather than merely copying writing, leading to increased cognitive fatigue rather than leisure.
